phases: Add _check_total helper and T1-T8; T3/T4 seed the marker between the n0-th and (n0+1)-th record, T6 seeds out-of-order records, T8 seeds a marker equal to the anchor; confirm T1, T3, T4, T5, T6, T8 red
Add stall_walk.session_signature_timestamps, appending unconditionally and sorting each list ascending before return
Add inclusive flag to _suppression_active; anchor check_session_total on stamps[sig][-K] with inclusive=True and filter suppressed signatures before sorting and selecting
Replace the check_session_total docstring and rewrite doctrine 10.5 to describe both modes
Extend isolate_gates_dir to patch _workdir.root to tmp_path exactly
ci_commands: python -m pytest tests/test_cycle_count_escalator.py tests/test_session_total_signature_count.py tests/test_findings_signature_schema_parity.py tests/test_stall_walk.py tests/test_orchestration_override.py tests/test_session_id_path_safety.py tests/test_session_total_escalator_skill_wiring.py -q

limitations: The same-second guard is precautionary: measured across 188 real session histories there are zero same-second pairs and zero same-second K-tuples, so nothing in the repository history exercises T8
A decline suppresses that signature for K-1 further occurrences then re-arms
T3 and T4 discriminate the anchors only if the marker is seeded between the n0-th and (n0+1)-th record; a late marker silently makes T3 pass under every anchor
T6 is vacuous unless it seeds records whose file order is not ascending
No real session in the corpus has ever exceeded the K=3 threshold, so the anchor is pinned by tests and a stated contract, not by history
non_goals: GH #448 missing validate_session_id at the head of check_session_total; this phase adds a validating helper call AFTER the unvalidated read and must not be recorded as fixing it
